subject: ddl, domain, util: Stop polling tiflash-compute for table syncing status (#64709)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on DDL TiFlash replica progress/schema sync paths. The change consistently filters PD store lists to TiFlash write nodes only (label engine=tiflash) when calculating replica syncing progress and when triggering TiFlash schema sync; placement rules already constrain TiFlash replicas to engine=tiflash, so progress/availability remains aligned with the actual replica stores while avoiding polling tiflash_compute nodes. No Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine issues found in the touched DDL/infosync behavior.
